note: google/wire injector. Go has no annotation or type-directed DI signal; explicit container registration (wire.Build / wire.NewSet, fx.Provide / fx.Invoke, dig.Provide / dig.Invoke) is the only AST-visible shape. SEMANTICS DIFFER FROM OTHER LANGUAGES: Go INJECTS reads 'injector FUNCTION registers provider FUNCTION', not 'consumer class receives service'. UserStore is the injected interface type; it is the node that anchors the matrix's injects kind set (SERVICE/CLASS/INTERFACE), which has no FUNCTION entry.
